item.title: 0xA1_5 - World Line
item.description:
Mission · World Line
Objective
Calibrate the world-line deviation instrument and return Fang Li to his original world.
You are
Fang Li, a researcher—at least for now.
Clue
Two earlier articles on this blog: “I’m back, but I’ll soon set out again” and “Blog Version II Is Here” 。

All three boxes have been found.

That night, just after you lie down in the dormitory, the voice in your head returns.

item.title: 0xA1_4 - Floating
item.description:
Mission · Floating
Objective
Open the third box floating on the lake.
You are
Fang Li, a researcher. Kate is still beside you.
Clue
Another blog post on the tablet. One character is wrong—it is waiting for you to fix it.

The third box is not in the laboratory.

Kate leads you into a room filled with screens. The screens show a lake. Its surface is so still it does not look real.

item.title: 0xA1_3 - Decoding
item.description:
Mission
Goal
Read what is inside the black box.
You are
Fang Li, researcher. The black boxes are already printed.
Clue
A song MV. Pause, drag the timeline, and even inspect it frame by frame—the controls are below the video.

When you return to the lab after dinner, the 3D printer has stopped.

There are two black boxes on the tray, not one: one orange and one gray.

“…Buy one, get one free?”

item.title: 0xA1_2 - Full Moon
item.description:
Mission
Objective
Find the penultimate sentence of the “Full Moon” blog, enter it into the instrument, and print the black box.
You are
Fang Li, a researcher. Kate is your intern.
Clue
“Full Moon” is a real article on this blog. Open it, read it, and try to click it.

Kate leads you into a laboratory.

【First, one thing.】The Cloak’s voice sounds. 【The 2014 you are in now is different from the one you remember—even some scientific principles are different.】

item.title: 0x07 - Dead Elephant
item.description:
Task · Dead Elephant
Target
Hear Fireclaw finish telling the story of the first time she met Earfish.
You are
In this chapter, “I” am Fireclaw.
Clue
Character cards: Earfish 、 Dead Elephant 。If you took the “Black Box” route, you will recognize a sentence. Theme song: Listen on NetEase Cloud Music 。

I

When the tavern rose in the rain, I remembered the first day I met Earfish.

It was raining that day too.

item.title: 0x04 - Tavern
item.description:
Task · Tavern
Target
Spend your first night in a tavern with a cloak.
You are
bystander.
Clue
Fireclaw in the character card; and the end of the novel One in Fifty Thousand . Theme song: Listen to on NetEase Cloud Music.

After learning to move, the cloak passed through the jungle, and the first place it encountered was a quiet tavern.

The pub owner is a bear. He had one injured ear and the other ear was shaped like a fish gill. His eyes were pale green.

item.title: 0x03 - Seeing
item.description:
Mission · One Hundred Years 3/3
target
helmet recognizes the first symbol it sees.
You are
bystander.
Clue
Two Hundred Thousandths , some words are replaced with strange numbers.

Thousands of years have passed.

The longer and taller the jungle, the green climbed over the body of the cloak, reaching all the way to the blue-white sky.

The moment the cloak opened its eyes, it began to rain heavily.

He lowered his head and saw himself in the muddy puddle. There’s a symbol floating on the water that it doesn’t recognize yet, and it looks like this:

item.title: 0x02 - Hear
item.description:
Mission · One Hundred Years 2/3
target
help the cloak learn to listen.
You are
bystander.
Lead
or Two Hundred Thousandths .

The cloak learns to listen before it sees.

At first, it can only hear itself breathing. The farther apart the two breaths are, the more violent vibrations it can hear. Occasionally, these vibrations resonate with other beings.

The cloak could not see what those beings were, and could only remember their voices: hurried, soothing, dry, viscous.

item.title: [A-4249] Master Datong
item.description:
Appearance

  • An ordinary sofa found almost anywhere.
  • (To be added.)

Function

  • Rest.
  • (To be added.)

Identity four hundred years ago

The legendary owner of a grand hotel.

Beliefs

Three rules for merchants

  1. Never profit from information asymmetry.
  2. Never profit from human weakness.
  3. A merchant must never sell themselves cheaply.

The Principle of Communication

  1. Self-emotional control.
  2. Use at least three methods.
  3. Never stop trying time-division multiplexing.

Notes

  • True name: Shenxiu.
  • Four hundred years ago, the legendary hotel owner; even earlier, a courier who delivered parcels to Paulson Wall (“Hello, Hao Kuai Express!”, see A Slow Scream ).
  • In Fang Li’s mind, he is the quiet voice, the master. In EarFish’s tavern, he is the singing sofa that secretly learned the “StarNet.”
  • Appears in: 0xA2 Ice Cola .

item.title: [A-4597] EarFish
item.description:
Appearance

  • Species: bear.
  • Fur: brown, yellow, and red, mainly brown.
  • Eyes: sage green.
  • Ears: one injured bear ear; the other is fan-shaped and closer to a fish gill.

Hearing and respiration

  • Though EarFish has a normal bear’s nose, breathing is actually done through the ears.
  • Because the ears must also handle hearing, more kinds of sound can be heard.

Identity | clothing

In 2442, EarFish runs the tavern in 0x04 , wearing a bartender uniform.

item.title: [C-0321] Purify Cu Husburd
item.description:
Profession

Alchemist.

Abilities

Green-flame metal control

Can use flame tests to create green-metal substances:

  • Copper (emerald green)
  • Boron (blue-green)
  • Barium (yellow-green)
  • Zinc (blue-green or colorless)

Barium

Barium has limited industrial uses. It was once used as a getter in vacuum tubes and is a component of YBCO high-temperature superconductors and electrical porcelain. Barium compounds produce green fireworks. Insoluble barium sulfate is added to drilling mud and used as an X-ray contrast agent; soluble barium salts are toxic and have been used as rat poison.

item.title: [D-XXXX] Dead Elephant
item.description:
An old elephant was watched by the Green Eye as it died. Its body was transformed into a place.

Time and space are confused there. Cultural symbols from different regions mingle and generate different worlds.

They say that anyone afraid of death can see a red sea and rain that never stops.

A bear-like person named EarFish sometimes passes through this place, and always notices a cat-like person named Burning Claws.

item.title: [H-1027] Nohara Aoi
item.description:
Before I could say “that’s it”

We often do not know how to express ourselves politely.

By the time we truly can express ourselves politely,

we find that we have grown so far apart.

To keep the signs from becoming obvious, we choose to hide our true selves.

And only when

Yesterday’s Sakura

the flowers

fall

do we realize

that so much has already passed,

item.title: [K-0122] The Desiring Absolute Rationalist
item.description:
Appearance

  • Appears to be 28–35; actual age unknown and irrelevant.
  • Pale-gold rings around sage-green pupils, with a faint iridescence in the light.
  • Minimal clothing: a playful T-shirt, a portable neural-recording ring, and a watch-like biometric sensor always at hand.
  • Usually wears a plain silver ring to fine-tune the focus of thought.

Personality and motives

  • MBTI: ENTJ. Treats emotion as noise, displaying “simulated emotion” only when needed to reduce friction in a negotiation.
  • Clear utility function: maximize long-term structural gains while keeping their reward system sustainably supplied.
  • Has desires and does not deny them: addicted to the clarity and sense of conquest brought by dopamine and endorphins, while abstracting desire into a tunable reward term.
  • Enjoys witnessing intellectual conquest—whether completing it personally or watching insight change a group’s strategic distribution. Either produces system-level pleasure.

Beliefs

  • Dogmas others oppose.
  • Dogmas others support.

item.title: [K-1647] Cloak
item.description:
Basic description

Physical composition

  1. Half carbon-based, half silicon-based life.
  2. A head with feline features.
  3. A hooded cloak; see the Clothing section.

Inner definition

  1. Transformed from somewhere unknown, it began contacting carbon-based life in search of its own definition.
  2. Does not get hungry, but understands how to enjoy food.

Clothing

The cloak

  1. Worn and old.
  2. Color-changing. By default it matches the wearer’s color range and includes a hood.
  3. The form beneath the cloak is normally slender and covered with catlike fur, but changes with the forms of carbon-based life encountered during the previous seven days.

The hood

  1. Its outline follows the wearer’s cat ears. The hood is usually down.
  2. During the day, contact with carbon-based life produces extra knowledge, temporarily stored in the hood.
  3. At night, the hood must be worn to digest the knowledge gathered during the day.

External connections

  1. Birthplace: daytime in an unknown jungle.
  2. Birth time: unknown.

Notes · voices inside the mind

  • A K-1647 model contains multiple modules; up to 42 can communicate at once (see Two in One Hundred Thousand ).
  • In the story they speak with different brackets: 【】 is Cloak, the observation module; 〖〗 is the emotion module; /…/ is the master.
  • Appears in 0x01 Breathing .

item.title: [S-6459] Catherine Wall
item.description:
Traits

  • Species: python person.
  • Age: 30 (pythons can live 30–45 years or longer).
  • Gender: female.

Identities she does not volunteer

  1. Daughter of Paulson Wall.
    • Her father’s fame as a detective made her feel watched from childhood.
  2. Friend of Burning Claws.
    • A person has many things to protect, but few people to protect.
  3. Guardian of ChristieChurch.
    • One of the things she protects.

Social roles

  • Main job: front-desk receptionist, 24 years’ experience.
  • Secondary job: medical student, 23 years of part-time experience.
  • Hobby: painting.

Notes

  • Looking for the Green Eye.
  • Many people are looking for her: Fang Li on the black-box route, Shenxiu on the hotel route, and Zhi Shang on the Moon route…
  • Appears in 0xA1 Awakening and 0xA9 The Little Black Box .
Spoiler · Read after solving “Floating”
  • At age seven she drew a picture of a green sky: “Catherine, age seven, for Dad.”
  • Her mother is the “her” Paulson cannot stop thinking about in One in Fifty Thousand .

item.title: [Ω-9] Void Kasa
item.description:
Often, memories are like a maze in the void, surfacing from time to time in our minds.

We wander through the maze, lost and unsure how to face our past selves.

We feel estranged, regretful, and sometimes even in pain.

But, but, fortunately, we have sound—and layers of sound across different times and spaces.

These layers can go further, allowing every person—every person—in a maze amid a different life

to know

item.title: 0x01 - Breathing
item.description:
Mission · One Hundred Years 1/3
target
help the cloak learn to breathe.
You are a
bystander. The protagonist of this line is a cloak.
clue
cloak is a kind of existence called K-1647. Instructions for K-1647, written in the novel Two Hundred Thousandths .

A shabby Cloak appears in the spring jungle.

The shape inside the cloak was erratic. It has no self and no voice.

“Where is this place?” the cloak asked in its heart.

item.title: 0xA0 - Selection
item.description:
Prologue
target
choose a way to start.
You are
yourself. People who are reading these words.
Lead
This chapter has no puzzles.

In the age of the internet, how can you possibly think you’re in control?

In the era of big models, how can you think that your mind is active enough?

[Reasonable. Because you think you’ll never see something again, and you can’t record it.]

A voice. It’s calm, clear, like a manual.

item.title: 0xA1 - Awakening
item.description:
Mission
Goal
Find out where you are and who you are.
You are
Unknown.
Clue
There is no puzzle in this chapter. Just keep reading.

Your phone lights up. One line appears on the screen:

Playing a role is not difficult. You only need to choose, then act. Without a role, you are only nothingness. Good luck.

You cannot understand it. You do not remember when you fell asleep.

item.title: 0xA2 - Ice Cola
item.description:
Mission · Ice Cola
Goal
Prove who you are, then prove that the “Supreme Copper” before you is an impostor.
You are
A singing sofa. Long ago, you had a name.
Clue
Detective Paulson Wall’s first case, A Slow Scream. You appeared in it, if only for one line.

I

I am a sofa: the ordinary kind people rest on while I sing beneath them.

Today I sing Black Cat Appears in the Daytime , ending with an invitation to drink Ice Cola.

item.title: 0xA3 - Explosion
item.description:
Mission · Explosion
Goal
Understand Xigong’s performance: his age and the location of his “explosion.”
You are
A backstage worker watching from behind the curtain.
Clue
Every line spoken on stage, and the song he plays.

Open mic

A tuxedoed gentleman bounces onstage with a can of Ice Cola.

Xigong: Hello, I am Xigong, a musician. Actually, I am a senior researcher at an institute.

The audience guesses 100, 35, 18, and 40. Exactly one guess has the correct tens digit and one has the correct ones digit, but nobody is completely correct. He is under forty, and the 18-year-old guess is too low.

item.title: 0xA4 - S-Class Locked Room
item.description:
Mission · S-Class Locked Room
Goal
Solve an S-class locked-room case for Zhi Shang and submit the answer.
You are
An observer. The protagonist is new lunar energy-researcher Zhi Shang.
Clue
All case information appears in this chapter. The weapon’s name is written in One in Fifty Thousand.

I

The Locked-Room Energy Institute stands on the Moon. Researchers solve rooms randomly generated by the Chord system; correct answers produce energy. Zhi Shang ignores where the energy comes from. Every six months he must solve 100 A-class rooms or be transferred and eventually dismissed.

item.title: 0xA5 - The Green Eye
item.description:
Mission · The Green Eye
Goal
Find the Green Eye and understand why everyone is searching for it.
You are
Fang Li, still carrying the black-box investigation.
Clue
Follow the recurring green reflection and the voices in the records.

The instruments display fragments from several worlds. Every fragment contains the same sage-green glint: in a pupil, a monitor, a puddle, and the edge of a page. Kate says the glint is not a color but a witness.

item.title: 0xA9 - Little Black Box
item.description:
Mission · Little Black Box
Objective
Audit the little black boxes and find which one contains a clue to the Green Eye.
You are
An employee at a company, code-named “Socrates.” Your supervisor is Kate.
Clue
A case handled by Kate’s father: “Sixfold Answer: The Necklace 2” 。

“Socrates!!!!” A deafening howl.

You are startled by the noise. It is Kate, your supervisor, calling you.

“What is going on here?!” She slams a little black box onto your desk. You cannot see anything inside.

item.title: 0xB0 - The Last Distribution
item.description:
Mission · The Last Distribution
Goal
Distribute the final message and decide who receives it.
You are
A temporary courier between worlds.
Clue
The delivery order, the timestamps, and the empty address.

The last package has no sender and no destination. Its label contains only a sequence of times and the instruction: deliver when the rain stops.

Fang Li, Kate, Cloak, and the voices each interpret the label differently. The package passes through the tavern, the lunar institute, and the Dead Elephant. At every stop, someone insists that the message belongs to someone else.

item.title: Dictionary
item.description:
CiiaKua

Describes a quality of water. Its meaning varies by context; in 0x04 , it means something like muddy, dirty water.

Its pronunciation is close to the Mandarin Chinese word for “watermelon.”

Classical Latin: /ki.ja.kwa/

Ecclesiastical Latin: /tʃi.ja.kwa/

Italian: /ˈtʃja.kwa/ or /ˈtʃi.a.kwa/

Spanish, Latin American pronunciation: /ˈsja.kwa/

Spanish, Castilian pronunciation: /ˈθja.kwa/

French: /si.a.ky.a/ or /si.a.ku.a/

Portuguese: /ˈsja.kwa/

Husburd

In 0x04 , refers to a former head of household. Based on the Germanic languages of ancient Scandinavia and England; pronounced /ˈhʊs.bʊrd/.

  • Gender: male.

Identities he does not volunteer

  1. Friend of Paulson Wall.

  3. KuthorX.

Social role — coordinator

Main job

Software developer

Four years of part-time experience and seven years of professional experience.

item.title: Introduction to *The Last Case*
item.description:
Story Synopsis

The great detective of old, Polson Wall , entrusted his life to Dead Elephant through his final moments, passing it to K-1647 .

K-1647’s consciousness continually fused with Wall’s, splitting into Cloak , Fireclaw , and Earfish , then projecting them through the projector onto different planes.

  • Plane 0 Story of Cloak (storyline 0x00–0x0F)

    • Where the three characters first meet.

  • Plane A The Greenish Eye (storyline 0xA0–0xAF)

    • A chaotic timeline filled with puzzles.
    • Most tricks concern sound and colour; players solve them by mapping spectrograms and optical spectra.
    • Eleven cases are planned.

  • Plane B Katelyn Wall’s Last Case (storyline 0xB0–0xBF)
